New 2021 25th Anniversary Team Rider Ladies Wetsuits.  Designed with a custom female contoured cut to better fit a woman's physique.  Wetsuits are engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility.  "S-Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability.  Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

  • 2.5mm side movement panels for a PWC riders needed flexibility
  • Left shoulder velcro entry
  • Ankle zippers for easy on and off
  • All seams have an interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin

Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

Description:
Team Rider Wetsuit Jacket - Red

Retired Style - No additional sizes will be available

Limited Edition Series

New 2021 Team Rider Wetsuits - Sold as separate John & Jackets for the first time! Designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility.  "S-Tek" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability.  Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.  The new front angled zipper design is easier to pull up and down with less stress on the suit.

Hybrid Jacket Top Features Include: 

  • Hybrid Jacket with built-in hood for keeping warm between rides
  • New Ergonomic Angled Marine Grade Zipper (designed at an angle, not straight up and down)
  • Jacket can be worn with a sleeveless wetsuit john, shorts, or swimwear to stay warm
  • Dual Purpose cut, not as restricting as a traditional wetsuit top (vest is worn over the jacket)
  • Not an oversized cut like a tour coat
  • 3mm neoprene in chest and back (works best for temps down to 50-55F degrees)
  • "S-Tek" neoprene for improved stretch and durability
  • 2.5mm side movement panels for a PWC riders needed flexibility
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin

Matching Team Rider Red Sleeveless John Sold Separately

 

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit jacket purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit jacket is designed to be a tight fit.  Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit jacket size.

 

Return/Exchange Policy: If the size you receive still does not work for your body type/frame, returns and exchanges may be requested within 30 days of delivery for new, unused wetsuits returned in original condition and original packaging.  Wetsuits must follow our wetsuit folding policy to ensure the wetsuit is not creased or damaged in shipping. Link: Wetsuit Return Instructions Returns are subject to inspection upon arrival. Wetsuits that have been used, washed, dirty, stained, or are damaged due to pet hair, smoke exposure, or creased are not eligible for a refund/exchange.

Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back. Title: RS-25P Fade Side Entry Impact Vest | Blue / Orange | Customization Option | PWC Jet Ski Ride & Race
Description:
RS-25 Side Entry Impact Vest - Blue / Orange

Jettribe 25th Anniversary Edition- RS-25 Side Entry Impact Race Vest. Updated style and enhanced features make this vest excellent for closed course racing , offshore endurance racing , and naturally for recreation PWC riding as well. The most important feature is the built-in high density, EVA compression molded chest plate. The plate in RS-25 offers more protection than traditional life vests to help reduce effects from chest Impacts. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider's body, the pre-formed mold allows the vest to flex and conform to each rider's chest and back. The main feature is incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. 
The Vest is SGS buoyancy rated to meet or exceed USCG floatation standards. Our proprietary process compresses a 4-inch EVA foam down to 2-inches for a lighter , more comfortable vest with maximum flotation.

New Design Includes:

  • Upgraded Black Lanyard Attachment
  • New Velcro Patch Strap Attachment
  • Enhanced Customizable Back Plate
  • 3-Point Strap Reinforcements
Product Features
  • Pre-Molded Front and Back Foam for a contoured, flexible fit 
  • Side-Entry Impact Design optimized for racing and recreation 
  • High-Density EVA Chest Plate for superior impact protection
  • SGS Buoyancy Rated to make meet or exceed USCG standards
  • 4-inch EVA compressed to 2-inch for lightweight, maximum flotation 
  • 420 Denier Honey Comb Weave for extreme outer durability
  • Back Deflector Compatible for integrated spinal safety
  • Upgraded Black Lanyard Attachment for secure Kill-Switch connection
  • New Velcro Patch Attachment for custom flags and designs
  • Customizable Back Plate for Name and Race Number attachment
  • 3-Point Strap Reinforcements with heavy-duty- zig-zag bar tacks 
Customizable Racing Plate - Back 

This plate has the option ($60 optional fee) to add you Race Name and Number. Proudly display your name / team and race number on the race course. Added benefit - avoid scoring errors on closed-course races. Worn by the best Professional Watercraft Racers in the World.

Product Features: 
  • Designed to attach to the back side of any Side-Entry Vest
  • Made of a Nylon with integrated PVC Plastic Panel
  • Customization with Heat-Transferred Vinyl Lettering for $60 (allow 1-2 weeks for customization) 
  • Plate attaches around the the shoulder straps at the top, and around the vest side straps at the bottom
  • Please note this is not a spinal protection device

 

Please Note: We cannot print profane or offensive customization.

Title: Circuit 2 Piece Wetsuit Set | Pink | John & Jacket
Description:
Circuit John & Jacket Wetsuit 2 Piece Set - Pink

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

2 Piece Set - Includes sleeveless john and a long sleeve jacket
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall
  • Jettribe wetsuits have built in movement panels to help a PWC rider flex side-to-side
  • Built with 2.5mm neoprene in the chest, back, and legs (comfortable in water temps as low as 62-68F)
Product Features
  • Abrasion resistant wire mesh neoprene in the seat and knees
  • Left shoulder velcro entry
  • Ankle zippers for easy on and off
  • 2nd Generation "S.Tec" neoprene for improved stretch and durability. Soft and comfortable.
  • Vivid and Bright Screenprinted Graphics
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Marine-grade zipper on the jacket top

 

    

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your wetsuit size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.


Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit size.

Return/Exchange Policy: If the size you receive still does not work for your body type/frame, returns and exchanges may be requested within 30 days of delivery for new, unused wetsuits returned in original condition and original packaging. Wetsuits must follow our wetsuit folding policy to ensure the wetsuit is not creased or damaged in shipping. Link: Wetsuit Return Instructions Returns are subject to inspection upon arrival. Wetsuits that have been used, washed, dirty, stained, or are damaged due to pet hair, smoke exposure, or creased are not eligible for a refund/exchange.

Description:
Custom Hoodie Sweatshirt JTR Series - Red

The Jettribe JTR Series Customizable Hoodie Sweatshirt is engineered for maximum warmth using a thick, heavy polyester blend and a double-layered micro mesh liner designed to circulate heat around the body. This unisex design features a front muff pocket, strong plastic string pull-tabs for hood adjustment, and premium embroidered logos. Utilizing a sublimation gas fusion process, your custom action photo is infused into the fabric for a soft-touch finish that will not fade or crack.

3-Step Customization Process - Pro-Level Customization
  • Includes a personalized name and race number with custom body and shadow colors. 
  • Features an option to upload your own JPEG photo for a unique, personalized background.
  • Direct access to our design experts via yourway@jettribe.com for artwork support and verification.
Product Features
  • On-shore warmth and style engineered specifically for comfort after riding.
  • Polyester blend with thick, heavy material provides a durable, premium feel.
  • Strong plastic string pull-tabs allow for easy adjustment of the neck and hood.
  • Front muff pocket offers convenient storage and hand warmth.
  • Embroidered logos add a high-quality, professional finish.
  • Unisex design ensures a great fit for both men and women.
  • Micro Mesh Heat Circulation technology utilizes a double-layered micro mesh liner to help circulate heat around the body.
  • Grey inside liner provides a stylish contrast to the exterior design.
  • Additional warmth is ensured by the structured, layered lining.

UR-20 Vest - Hot Water The Movie Official Merchandise

Jettribe is proud to be the official gear partner for the movie Hot Water, Directed by Larry Rippenkroeger

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest.  Instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back. The Jettribe UR-20P Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

Product Features

The UR-20P side entry vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  It will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.  Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. The 3 rescue handles help others pull a downed rider back up on their ski.

  • 3 Rescue Handles
  • Adjustable Side Entry Straps

  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your wetsuit size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.


Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit size.

Return/Exchange Policy: If the size you receive still does not work for your body type/frame, returns and exchanges may be requested within 30 days of delivery for new, unused wetsuits returned in original condition and original packaging. Wetsuits must follow our wetsuit folding policy to ensure the wetsuit is not creased or damaged in shipping. Link: Wetsuit Return Instructions Returns are subject to inspection upon arrival. Wetsuits that have been used, washed, dirty, stained, or are damaged due to pet hair, smoke exposure, or creased are not eligible for a refund/exchange.

Decal Off Remover | Vinyl Adhesive Cleaning Spray

Decal Off is a water based, ready-to-use product for:

  • Removal of specialty adhesive-backed vinyl from OEM factory cured finishes and most non-porous surfaces
  • Removal of remaining adhesive after decal removal

Directions:

  • Best results achieved on warm surface, area, warm to touch (95°F/35°C)
  • Shake gently.
  • Apply liberally to surface of product selected for removal.
  • Let stand for 5 minutes.
  • Raise an edge and pull at approximately a 35° angle.
  • If there is any adhesive remaining, apply liberally to remaining adhesive.
  • Let stand 1 minute.
  • Scrape, wipe or wash off.
  • Rinse surface with water to end the removal action.

Aftermarket parts may change the shape of your ski and may not allow the cover to fit properly.
